goal: Port the earned-knowledge schema (constraints/products/capability-gaps/compositions) from pmcro-skills-lagacy into this repo, adapted to this repo's real capabilities (no pmcro-loop plugin, plain-GUID trail IDs), per the user's explicit choice after they corrected my earlier proposal to build a new plugin instead.

Port each schema into .pmcro/, adapted: remove/replace every reference to the nonexistent plugins/pmcro-loop scripts with a description of the record being authored directly (by the Reflector or whichever role made the promotion judgment), and flag that this repo trail IDs are plain GUIDs with no cycle-/retro- prefix, so evidence_class/proven fields are manual declarations here, not script-derived.

Create the four corresponding empty directories (.pmcro/constraints, products, capability-gaps, compositions) with .gitkeep placeholders, without porting any of the legacy repos own populated records -- those are that repos operational history, not this repos, mirroring the existing precedent in .pmcro/memory/README.md.

Verify the two pre-existing reference docs that already pointed at these schemas (trail-as-product.md, capability-gap-and-composition.md) are still internally consistent after the port -- they also referenced the nonexistent plugin, so a light correction was needed there too rather than leaving new, accurate schema docs contradicted by old, inaccurate narrative docs.
Confirm git status is limited to the intended new/modified files, commit, and push.

success_criteria: All four schema files exist under .pmcro/ with content verbatim-sourced from pmcro-skills-lagacy@main, not invented

Every reference to plugins/pmcro-loop or its scripts is either removed or clearly marked as not applicable in this repo, with an honest explanation of what happens here instead (direct authorship, no script)
The two pre-existing reference docs that already pointed at these schemas remain internally consistent with the newly-ported, corrected schema docs

No content from the legacy repos own populated constraint/product/gap/composition records is copied into this repo -- only the schema documents, matching the precedent already set for .pmcro/memory/README.md

out_of_scope: Building plugins/pmcro-loop or any deterministic script for writing these records -- the user explicitly said this is not wanted; the Reflector (or relevant role) authors records by hand per the schema

Fixing capability-gap-and-composition.md's other stale references (discover-capabilities skill, INSTRUCTIONS.md, /createskill) -- confirmed none of these exist in this repo either, but that is a separate, pre-existing gap not part of this port and not raised by the user this cycle
Writing any actual constraint/product/gap/composition record -- this cycle only ports the schema and empty directories; a record gets written the first time a future cycle actually earns one
